summary: Mitchell County tower on North Carolina's tower list; a 2008 summary of Barr's guidebook says it was dismantled and burned around 1970. No source describes the site now.

facts.status_note: Dismantled and burned around 1970, according to a 2008 summary of Peter Barr's guidebook.

events.note: Dismantled and burned, ca. 1970, per the blog's summary of Barr's guidebook. Erection date given as unknown.

notes_for_editor: Fate and erection come from one secondary source: a 2008 blog post summarizing Peter J. Barr's guidebook (erected unknown; dismantled and burned ca. 1970). No agency, register or primary record found. The tnlandforms list gives only the location. A Facebook group post mentioning a Devils Nest fire tower could not be read and is not used. Nothing found on the site today or its access.
